description:
Fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work.

Skriuw is a fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work. Version 2 keeps the workspace in local SQLite storage with portable archives and Git-backed history.
Changes since v2-v0.54.0
- chore(v2): release v2-v0.55.0
- feat(ai): automatic journal titles and Anthropic, OpenAI and OpenRouter providers
- chore(sync): add a prompt script for the OAuth client secrets
- feat(workspace): show the due date slot and its D key on unscheduled task rows
- fix(workspace): draw tree guides under the parent icon so the setting is visible
- fix(workspace): pad task rows so the hover highlight clears the checkbox
- feat(workspace): bring back the sidebar action row with its animated search swap
- fix(packaging): warn instead of failing when the winget token lacks workflow scope
- feat(packaging): broaden package-manager coverage
- feat: light themes, desktop OAuth sign-in, mobile tasks ledger and tree drag (#592)
- feat(mobile): give every control press feedback and stop the toolbar repeating screen titles
- feat(workspace): add an on-screen keyboard dock
- feat(mobile): add a password reveal toggle and iOS autofill hints to the sign-in form
- fix(site): build the web app into the Vercel deployment again (#591)
- style(workspace): sweep a shimmer across the theme tiles (#590)
- style(workspace): fade the splash bars in and sweep a shimmer across them (#589)
- style(workspace): redesign the note lock dialogs and unlock pane as a ledger (#588)

- feat(workspace): redesign the trash view as a ledger (#586)
- feat(desktop): check for and install updates from inside the app (#582)
- test(e2e): look up the version list by its Revisions label (#583)
- chore(site): route skriuw.com, www and docs domains to the site worker (#585)
- feat(workspace): rebuild the command palette around scope tabs and a preview (#584)
- feat(workspace): redesign the database views as a ledger (#581)
- feat(workspace): redesign version history as a ledger (#580)
- style(workspace): drop left-edge bars from active rows (#579)
- feat(workspace): rebuild the note inspector as one scrolling column (#578)
- feat(desktop): print the version for -v and --version (#577)
